itens.titulo: Chevron Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Margins
itens.descricao: Chevron Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Margins Yahoo Finance
trechos: energy supermajor Chevron Corporation CVX reported adjusted third-quarter 2026 earnings per share of $5.28, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $4.78.
The 10.5% earnings surprise reflected higher refined product sales margins, improved crude oil realizations and reliable operations.
The bottom line surged 185.4% from the year-ago adjusted profit of $1.85 per share.
The integrated energy giant generated revenues of $67.8 billion, exceeding the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $60.5 billion by 12.1%.
Revenues increased 36.3% year over year.
refineries achieved record crude throughput of 1.09 million barrels per day, operating at nearly 98% utilization.

CVX's Upstream Earnings Rise on Stronger Pricing Chevron's worldwide net oil-equivalent production averaged 3,980 thousand barrels of oil-equivalent per day (MBOE/d), declining 2.6% from 4,086 MBOE/d a year earlier.
The upstream segment recorded earnings of $5.7 billion, increasing 72.6% from $3.3 billion in the year-ago quarter.

itens.titulo: Intel Dropped 20% Over The Last Month: This Pro Analyst Says It’s Going to Gain 70% Soon
itens.descricao: Intel Dropped 20% Over The Last Month: This Pro Analyst Says It’s Going to Gain 70% Soon Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - INTC fell 20% last month after Q4 guidance cut EPS to $0.25 and gross margin to 38%, far below prior-quarter results.
- AMD fell just 7% and NVDA slipped 6% over the same period, underscoring Intel's company-specific problems beyond the broader chip selloff.
- Management projects server CPU unit growth above 30% annually in 2026 and 2027, as the market could expand from $40 billion to $200 billion.
Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) is priced at $92.07.
The average Wall Street price target of $117.71 points to 27.8% upside.
Intel designs and builds x86 processors for PCs and servers, and it is trying to grow a contract foundry business on the side.
Data Center & AI (DCAI) revenue rose 78% YoY to $7.32B last quarter.
The most bullish 12-month target goes to John Vinh at KeyBanc Capital Markets, at $155.00.
